en.headline: Observatory forecasts heavy showers Saturday, sunnier Sunday for Hong Kong
en.dek: Heavy showers and a few squally thunderstorms are expected early on Saturday before easing, with sunny periods on Sunday and temperatures between 23 and 28 degrees.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said an easterly airstream is affecting the coast of Guangdong, bringing mainly cloudy conditions with showers that are expected to increase at night and into Saturday.

According to the Observatory, Saturday will see heavy showers with a few squally thunderstorms at first, which will ease off during the day as the weather improves, with sunny periods in the afternoon. Temperatures are forecast to range from 23 to 27 degrees.
Sunday is expected to bring sunny periods with temperatures between 24 and 28 degrees. No weather warnings are currently in force, and the public is advised to monitor updates for any changes.

zh.headline: 天文台料周六初時驟雨雷暴 周日有陽光
zh.dek: 周六初時有大驟雨及幾陣狂風雷暴，日間雨勢減弱並轉好，周日有陽光，氣溫約23至28度。
body: 香港天文台表示，一股偏東氣流正影響廣東沿岸，本港大致多雲，驟雨預料晚上及周六增多。
天文台指，周六初時有大驟雨及幾陣狂風雷暴，日間雨勢減弱，天氣轉好，下午有陽光。氣溫約23至27度。
周日預料有陽光，氣溫約24至28度。目前並無天氣警告生效，市民應留意最新天氣資訊。
